display_name: 旧类间隔约束LocalRidge与support监督adapter联合适应注册
description: 固定Phase1和输入矩阵；B解析核岭回归，C继承actual B并求解全物理旧类间隔约束QP，联合隐式梯度监督adapter；数学结构优化，无参数网格。
input_identity_source: Fixed source-only cache/capsule/model/split metadata; no scored output, adapted state or index supplied to fitting
notes: Fixed input matrix: 2 smallest source model seeds x2cohorts, four rows/160parents; old6; K1/5/10/20; new0/2/5/10/20; no selection from performance.
practical residual/post_sync/noeq/25MHz; existing p2_min_v1/VALIDATED_ONCE support-only raw frozen caches. No data rebuild, checkpoint load, source sample/per-record source feature or query access.
B analytic Affine LocalRidge. C freezes actual current B, pads new columns zero, and learns residual with every physical old training point versus every registered other class.

Old margin lower bound d_i is minimum actual B true-vs-other raw margin, without clipping negative values. Does not freeze every old score to zero residual. Every old/new support label still participates in the training loss.
For fixed geometry the convex RKHS objective is support squared residual loss + RKHS norm with unpenalized free intercept and old margin inequalities. Feasible zero residual is retained.

Outer adapter objective class RMSCE only; complete K/L endpoints, free intercept and active multipliers differentiated by regular KKT; no proximal gradient or detached head. No jitter/pinv/fallback for unsupported Jacobian.

Frozen four accepted iterations, at most12 backtracking trials each, initial step0.125, hard coordinate ball0.5, actual projected displacement Armijo1e-4; same last-accepted rule. Not a parameter search.
new0 actual B object reuse; K1/rank0/no inner-held no adapter updates; tau0 all physical rows retained. Preserve failures and let healthy lanes finish; no automatic retry or low-score stopping.

QP max_transitions4096 is finite technical work guard, not a convergence theorem. factor_buffer160MiB covers generic max owned input+factor141.455MiB at n520,q3000; current outer-held training max69.313MiB. Neither is process RSS or satellite budget.
Pure QP s0 vector and C geometry reference_s0 scalar use distinct archives; full constraints/KKT/head/VJP and actual work independently verified after fixed support predictions.
Ground A will be a separate frozen-prediction paired supplement, using exact same old held records; A/B-A remain null until that completes. R0 or another method B cannot replace A.
Ideal B-A>=10pp, B-C_old<=1pp, abs(old-new)<=3pp are soft targets. Support diagnostics cannot establish query/generalization, independent confirmation or automatic promotion.

Detailed text + full training NPZ and compact scalar JSONL/CSV; trainable coordinates/time/RSS/state/factor work/transfer bytes report actual measured values or N/A. Few trainable parameters alone does not prove low star cost.
